messages.author: 79739110d9cc0ecd
messages.subject: Sourcing data via JDBC
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to use Renjin to massage some reports coming back from PostgreSQL.

So I was wondering if there is an example of how to do this?

If not, how would I go about doing this? It looks like you can feed data into the runtime by using a Vector data structure. Should I potentially be looking at backing some kind of VectorArray with a JDBC result set?

Any help is appreciated,

Ben

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Sourcing data via JDBC
parts:
Hi Ben,
Sorry for the late response. 

You've got it exactly right. It's been on my list for while to put together a jdbc package for Renjin but haven't had the time yet. 

You could either load the ResultSet into a set of DoubleArrayVector, StringArrayVectors etc when the query is executed, so that you can release the ResultSet, or if you know the underlying data isn't going to change, you can defer the query execution until it's actually needed. 

HTH,
Alex
